name: Addoncraft Repeater For Elementor ACF
author: AddonsCraft

sections.description:
Addoncraft Repeater for Elementor ACF lets you display ACF Repeater fields in Elementor—design once, it auto-repeats dynamically

Perfect for:
– Team member listings
– Pricing tables
– Testimonials
– Services grids
– Any repeating content managed with ACF

No coding required – just design once in Elementor, connect to your ACF Repeater, and Addoncraft Repeater For Elementor ACF will handle the rest!

🔑 Features

  • Integrates ACF Repeater fields with Elementor
  • Supports Elementor templates & widgets
  • Works with Elementor Pro Dynamic Tags
  • Easy setup with no custom coding
  • Lightweight and optimized for performance

📝 Tagline

Build unlimited dynamic loops with Elementor & ACF Repeater. Design once, repeat everywhere – fast, flexible, and code-free.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/addoncraft-repeater-for-elementor-acf or install via the WordPress plugin installer.
  2. Activate Addoncraft Repeater For Elementor ACF from the Plugins screen.
  3. Make sure you have Advanced Custom Fields (ACF) and Elementor installed and activated.
  4. Create or edit a page with Elementor.
  5. Add your Repeater field via ACF.
  6. Use Addoncraft Repeater For Elementor ACF’s dynamic loop controls to display your ACF Repeater fields.
sections.faq:
Do I need ACF Pro?

Yes, because the Repeater Field is only available in ACF Pro.

Do I need Elementor Pro?

Not strictly, but some advanced dynamic tag features may require Elementor Pro.

Will this slow down my website?

No – Addoncraft Repeater For Elementor ACF is lightweight and optimized for performance.

Can I use it with custom Elementor templates?

Yes, you can loop through ACF Repeater fields inside any Elementor template.
